title: Who Owns The Doorway
the_thought: Apple owns the phone doorway. OpenAI wants the next one.

levels.name: The Short
beats: OpenAI wants the next one. They shook hands in June 2024. ChatGPT went inside Apple phones. Reporting later said the window stayed tiny. OpenAI had hoped for billions. The reporting said that hope didn't come close. Then Apple sued. Apple alleges trade secrets to speed hardware. OpenAI called the suit wrong. It asked a judge to throw the complaint out. The fight isn't one insult. It is about who owns the customer. Follow the money. The doorway is the plot.
